cover.sub: 3 FREE BLUEPRINTS + 1 CAMO · HOW TO GET THEM

steps: Land on *Trackline*, go up to the roof room in the *SE corner*
Use the *computer* to call the drones (retry if needed)
Let them land, open only the *orange crates*
secrets.tip: Not in the crates? Try again next match.

steps: Buy the *nuke* at a Buy Station
Call it in. Your first nuke unlocks it
secrets.tip: 1 nuke per match. First come, first served.

steps: Swap your gun at a *Weapon Trade Station*
Do it *25 times*. Any weapon counts
secrets.tip: Trade during a Fire Sale for better guns.

steps: Push your score to *100* in Rally Point
Grab a *Classified Weapon* from the purple drop
Get *10 player kills* with it. Bots don't count
secrets.tip: You respawn with it in Rally Point.

cards.how: Throw *$10,000* into the flames. Bonus: a *Phone EXE*.
Set the panels the way the *laptop* inside shows.
Clear all *8 weapon tasks* in *one match*.

grind.sub: THESE UNLOCK OVER A FEW SESSIONS

rows.how: Stop by all 10 POIs at least once
Get your name on a smart display
Blow up the yellow tanks on the trains
Pick up a Phone EXE in different matches
Read every note + play every recording

source: Windows Central (R. Devine, hands-on, updated 11.11.2026) + timesaver.gg (14.11.2026, status per secret) + official Warzone S1 patch notes quoted there (Rally Point: single nuke per match first-come; Classified Weapon hidden challenge unlocks its camo; Phone EXE). Left out as disputed: Metal Detector reward, Old Mines / sewer bunker door, Admin tac map (no account reward). Event camos (Violet Striker, Neutral Ground, Renaissance) not secret, left out.
notes: Inspired by a viral competitor cheat sheet (user 19.11.), own design + own wording, no copy. Planned Sun 22.11. 12:00 after preview OK. v2 layout 20.11.: reward-first, own line icons for cosmetic rewards (no official reward artwork published); weapon renders + CTA cut-out are our existing approved assets.
